name: region
title: Board region
description: The frame of one area of the board, an open frame with no fill (D-024): its label (grip, title and answered count) sits in a gap cut from the top border, in the middle, sliding left when the line is too short on screen to centre it beside the tools (open list and container title FE_02); on the right the mode row (README pick 1, mockup 05): six layout icons (grid, flow, lanes, radial, column, row), a divider and the settings cog. Hovering an icon or reaching the row by keyboard opens the layout popover; the cog opens the settings menu (Reset places). All drawn as one generic element whatever the mode. Cards and wires are drawn in their own layers (D-013), so the element is only the frame.

files.core: region-core.ts (regionState, regionNote, noteStage, noteBadge, commentLabel, NOTE_STAGE_TEXT, REGION_NOTE_EVENT, REGION_NOTE_RESIZE_EVENT, regionHolders, regionColour, REGION_COLOUR_DEFAULT, MODE_LABEL, MODE_HINT, agentChoiceText, RESET_NONE_HINT, PUT_BACK_NONE_HINT, WIDTHS_LABEL, widthsTip, RegionState, RegionNoteState, RegionNoteStage, RegionBadge, RegionNoteAction, RegionNoteEventDetail, RegionNoteResizeDetail, RegionHolder, retiredMarker, RegionRetired; no DOM); region-fresh.ts (regionFresh, RegionFresh: a fresh container's pill, freshCards flag; no DOM)
files.preview: region-preview.ts (previewStep, previewShown, PREVIEW_CLOSED: when the note preview is open, WCAG 1.4.13; no DOM)
files.template: region-template.ts (regionTemplate, holdersTemplate, regionIds: the only places the markup is built)
files.icons: region-icons.ts (MODE_ICON per mode, WIDTHS_ICON (match, own), COG_ICON, EYE_ICON; wrapped by the node pattern's svgIcon)
files.behaviour: region-row.ts (bindModeRow: the row's Tab stop and arrow keys, the popover and the settings menu; browser only); region-note.ts (bindNoteParts: Comment's badge, the note preview and the note block, their events and the block's height; browser only); region-title.ts (bindTitleTip: the cut title's full-text tip, on the shared hover tip packages/ui/src/tip/hover-tip.ts bindHoverTip; browser only); paused/paused.ts (pauseControls, shared with the node pattern; browser only)
files.styles: region.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only; the top padding states REGION_HEAD from packages/layout); region-narrow.css (the top line's narrow forms, after region.css); region-modes.css (the layout popover and its tiles, after region.css); region-note.css (the container note: Comment's badge, the preview, the note block); region-rail.css (the tool rail, toolRail flag: every rule scoped to data-rail; after region-note.css); region-fresh.css (a fresh container: its teal border and the pill, freshCards flag; after region-rail.css); tip/tip.css (the shared hover tip's box); paused/paused.css (a control paused while its board is locked, shared with the node pattern)

flaggedStates.fresh: freshCards flag (new-and-updated Design 3 and 4): the container holds a card new or updated since the person last engaged with any card in it (`container.fresh`, api.md 158); data-fresh on the frame, whose border takes --vb-state-fresh (teal; APCA on the canvas Lc 58.6 light, 67.4 dark), and after the count a pill (vb-region-fresh, in its own slot vb-region-fresh-slot) "3 new · 1 updated" (a part at zero left out; teal on --vb-state-fresh-soft, Lc 54.8 and 63.5), its full words ("3 new cards and 1 updated card in this container") its tooltip and for screen readers. It follows the label's shrink order: the holders give way first, then the pill, which leaves whole (its slot a wrapping row one line high, its second line clipped), then the title. Kept zoomed out: the line keeps its size. A dragged frame and a drop target keep their own border. Set by update from `RegionState.fresh` (the page's `regionFresh`); none in a past version.
flaggedStates.paused: lockBoard (N40 ruling 4; the state shows whatever the flag, since the lock is the ledger's): on a locked board (`RegionState.paused`, from `BoardState.locked`) the layout icons, the widths switch, the grip, Comment, the note's Edit and Remove, Reset places, Put container back and Remove access stay in place, aria-disabled and data-paused (paused/paused.ts, paused/paused.css: the quiet ink, no hover or press, the not-allowed pointer; the checked layout keeps its look); a press reaches the page, which says why. The cog still opens its menu, whose two rows show disabled; Show in container still works. A ledger open read-only (readOnlyStart, D-085; `BoardState.readOnly`) pauses the same controls.
flaggedStates.held: agentAccess flag: the region's holders after the count, the creator as plain text and every other holder as a Remove access button (D-027). Kept out of `states` so the gallery without the flag reads as before.
flaggedStates.note replies: cardReplies flag (FE_03): the agent's replies that name the note, in vb-nblock-replies under its text in the note block, oldest first: each (vb-nblock-reply, data-reply = its seq) has who (vb-nblock-who, 'Agent reply · label') over the text (vb-nblock-reply-text, Markdown, cut at three lines until "Show all"); read-only; empty with none. The note's text (vb-nblock-text) and each reply are tab stops: a click, Enter or Space opens the exchange beside it (vb-region-note open; popovers-larger-thread ruling 2)
flaggedStates.retired: retiredMarker flag (field report batch 2 ruling 1): after the count, "N retired" (vb-region-retired, a quiet button; review polish round 2 ruling 1) for the cards the agent retired one at a time from the container, named and titled in full words ("N cards retired from this container. Show vM, where they last appeared"); data-version is the board version a press opens (the last one before the latest such retire), aria-disabled with none to open. Never covered: when the line has no room for its words it shrinks to a small icon and its number (region-narrow.css); hidden below FAR_K with the controls.
flaggedStates.rail: toolRail flag (on by default; container tool rail, cortex-tasks/board/2026-10-25_board-ui_container-tool-rail.md): the tools group (.vb-region-tools: the row, the layout popover, the note preview, the settings menu; the same markup and order) sits in .vb-region-rail after the header instead of on the top line, and the frame carries data-rail; the top line holds the label alone, centred on the whole line at every zoom (its shrink order and tip as before). The rail is vertical, across the left border from just under the top line, 30px across on screen at every zoom (24px buttons), reaching 20px past the frame's edge (22 with its canvas ring, 25 with Comment's badge, which sits on its outer side) and 10px into it (12 with the ring): under REGION_GAP x FAR_K - 2 and REGION_PAD x FAR_K - 2, so it never touches the next container or a card. States: rail-rest (icons and divider at --vb-rail-rest; 0.5 in both themes: each icon APCA Lc 30 or more in light; dark is a trial under it, Lc 16.9 to 17.7 for the unchecked icons and the cog), rail-lit (full strength on hover, focus, data-open, data-preview or data-note-open, and always under (hover: none); the badge is never dimmed), rail-collapsed (under 275px of rail room on screen, 249 without the widths switch: the checked layout, Comment and the cog), rail-narrowest (under 112px: the cog, and Comment while the badge shows), rail-expanded (a collapsed rail hovered or focused: whole, placed by its foot so it grows upward and Comment and the cog stay under the pointer; the frame raised over the cards like data-open; Esc collapses it again, data-shut on the row, keeping the focused button drawn), rail-popover (the layout popover, the note preview and the menu open to the right of the rail, top-aligned with the layouts, Comment and the cog). The gallery draws the hovered look with data-look on .vb-region-tools. Render option `rail`; a fixed frame's rail holds only the cog.
flaggedStates.railOnHover: railOnHover flag (on by default; read-only follow-ups FE_03, point 416; needs toolRail): a container's rail icons and divider show only on the container in use. State rail-hidden (not in use: opacity 0, still focusable, nothing moves; Comment's badge still shows); in use (the frame hovered or holding focus, data-use for its cards): rail-rest, --vb-rail-rest as before; the rail itself hovered or focused: rail-lit, full strength. A touch screen (no hover) keeps every rail shown. Off, every frame shows the rail-rest look. Render option `railHover`, data-rail-hover on the frame.
flaggedStates.widths: widthsControl flag (field report batch 3 ruling 5): Match card widths, a switch (vb-widths, role switch) in the mode row after the divider, before Comment; one of the row's stops. aria-checked true (the checked look, the match icon) while every card in a column takes its widest card's width, false (the own icon) while each keeps its own; its title says which (widthsTip) and data-widths is the value a press sends (the page's `widths` act). Hover, focus and pressed are the row's segment looks. Never in a fixed frame. Render option `widths`.

attributes.data-mode: grid | flow | lanes | radial | column | row: the layout in force (set by update)
attributes.data-open: modes | menu: the layout popover or the settings menu is open (set by the row behaviour); the frame is then drawn above the cards
attributes.data-fresh: the container is fresh (freshCards flag, `container.fresh`): its teal border and the pill (set by update from RegionState.fresh)
attributes.data-drop: the frame is the drop target under a card dragged by its kind tab: a dashed accent line and a soft fill (set by the page, 3_FE_03 ruling 3)
attributes.data-rail: the tools are in the rail on the frame's left edge, not on the top line (set by render from the `rail` option; toolRail flag); region-rail.css scopes every rule to it and region-narrow.css's row forms skip it
attributes.data-rail-hover: with the rail, the rail icons and divider show only while the frame is in use (set by render from the `railHover` option; railOnHover flag); region-rail.css hides them, opacity only, on a frame that is neither hovered nor holding focus nor carrying data-use (the board's mark for the frame under the pointer or holding a card with focus, canvas/region-use.ts bindRegionUse; the gallery sets it to draw the in-use look)
attributes.data-fixed: the board sets the frame's layout (the built-in Later, 3_FE_03 ruling 5): no layout icons or popover, and no Comment, note preview or note block (Later takes no note); the grip and the cog stay (set by render)
attributes.data-dragging: the frame is being moved by its label (grip, title or count): grip dots shown, the handle tinted, cursor grabbing, no transform transition (set by the page, 3_FE_04 ruling 6, FE_02)
attributes.data-note-open: the container's note bubble is open: Comment drawn pressed; the preview closes (set by setNoteOpen)
attributes.data-badge: unsent | sent | none: Comment's badge "1", bright (accent) while unsent, quiet once sent and still waiting; none once answered (no badge drawn); absent with no note (set by update from RegionNoteState.badge; step 4G ruling 1)
attributes.data-note-stage: unsent | sent | answered: the latest note's stage, for the preview's and the block's state line and look; absent with no note (set by update). Not data-note, which the page's listener reads on cards
attributes.data-preview: the note preview is open under Comment; the frame is drawn above the cards like data-open (set by the note behaviour from previewShown)
attributes.data-title-tip-open: the cut title's full-text tip is open below the title; the frame is drawn above the cards like data-preview (set by the title behaviour; titleTip flag, which the page shows as data-title-tip on its world)
attributes.data-note-shown: the note block shows under the title line (the noteShown property; page state only, not in the ledger, step 4G ruling 3). Set as an attribute it takes effect on the next update; the property applies at once
attributes.--region: the frame colour as a CSS value, from regionColour (set by render; --vb-line-contrast by default, the Lines scale's next step above --vb-line-strong); the frame line reads it whole, the title and the active icon mix from it
attributes.aria-labelledby: region-<id>, the heading inside the frame (set by render)

methods.render(r: Region, opts?: { fixed?, empty: once per view version: data-region, role, aria-labelledby, --region, innerHTML = regionTemplate(r, opts) (the popover foot names r.mode, the agent's choice); `fixed` leaves out the layout icons and popover and sets data-fixed, `empty` replaces the empty message, `rail` puts the tools in the rail and sets data-rail, `railHover` (with rail) sets data-rail-hover; closes anything open
methods.update(st: RegionState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-mode, the icons' aria-checked and the row's Tab stop, the current tile, the count ("1/1" shown, its words as its title and a visually hidden copy; hidden with no items), Reset places and Put container back aria-disabled and their hints, Comment's aria-label (st.commentLabel) and data-badge, data-note-stage, the preview's and the block's text, state line and buttons from st.note, the empty message), so focus survives; the holders slot is redrawn from holdersTemplate only when the holders change. regionState's 6th argument `owed` (container ids pendingItems lists) decides waiting vs answered for a sent note; left out, a sent note counts as waiting
methods.setNoteOpen(open): the container's note bubble opened or closed: data-note-open; opening closes the preview
methods.noteShown (property, boolean): show or hide the note block (reflects data-note-shown). The element never sets it itself: the page does, on a vb-region-note show or hide
methods.noteHeight(): number: the note block's height in the frame's own (unscaled) pixels, its gap to the cards included; 0 while hidden or with no note. The same number vb-region-note-resize carries; the page passes it to layout as the container's extra top inset (step 4G2)
methods.titleLine(): the title line element, whose box the page passes through the note bubble's titleAnchor to place the container's bubble
methods.showPanel(what, { mode?, focus? }): opens the layout popover with mode highlighted, or the settings menu (focusing its item unless focus is false); the gallery draws its open samples with it

events: button[role=radio][data-mode] or button.vb-mtile[data-tile] click (pointer, Enter or Space) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the one mode action; the popover closes (a tile never takes focus on a pointer press; Enter on a focused tile returns the focus to its layout's icon)

mouse over a layout icon, or keyboard focus on one -> the popover opens with that layout highlighted and tied to the icon by aria-describedby; it closes on leaving the row and popover, on blur, Esc or a pick

Arrow keys move between the six layouts, Comment and the cog (one Tab stop for the row, roving tabindex); Home and End; ArrowDown on the cog opens its menu (in the rail, data-rail: ArrowRight opens it, ArrowDown moves on, and ArrowLeft in the menu closes it back to the cog; Esc with no popover open collapses a short frame's rail)
cog click -> the settings menu opens and its item takes focus; Esc or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the cog; Tab closes it
menuitem[data-reset] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin every node of the region; while aria-disabled (no card moved) the click is stopped in the element
menuitem[data-put-back] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin the container (board + region); while aria-disabled (Not moved) the click is stopped in the element

button[data-region-comment] click (pointer, Enter or Space; a stop of the row between the layouts and the cog) bubbles to the page -> the container's note bubble opens (the preview closes). Touch: with a note, the first tap opens the preview instead and the click is stopped in the element; a tap on Comment while the preview is open goes through

mouse over Comment, or keyboard focus on it, with a note -> the preview opens; it stays while the pointer is over Comment or the preview and while focus is in either; it closes when both are left, on Esc (focus back on Comment), on a press outside (touch) and when the bubble opens

vb-region-note (bubbles, CustomEvent): detail { region, action: 'edit' | 'remove' | 'show' | 'hide' | 'open', seq, reply? } from the preview's Edit (Open for a sent note) and Show in container / Hide, the note block's Edit and Remove, and a click, Enter or Space on the block's note text or a reply (open; reply = the reply's seq, absent for the note); seq is the latest note's. The page acts: edit opens the bubble, open opens it beside the part pressed with the note's replies (the exchange), remove writes note-remove, show / hide set noteShown

vb-region-note-resize (bubbles, CustomEvent): detail { region, height } whenever the note block's height (noteHeight) changes: shown, hidden (0), Show all / Show less, new text, a width change (ResizeObserver)
.vb-nblock-more click -> Show all / Show less (inside the element: aria-expanded, then a vb-region-note-resize)

the label (.vb-region-handle: grip, title and count; not the label's other buttons or its tip): a pointer drag moves the container, wired by the page (pointer.ts frameAt; 3_FE_04 rulings 5, 6, 8; FE_02, superseding 3_FE_01 ruling 6 for the label); held still, a click on the title is the frame background's click (it clears the selection). Alt+arrows stay on button.vb-region-grip. A drag on the rest of the line still pans, and so does a Cmd or Ctrl + drag anywhere; on a past version (read-only) the title pans
mouse over the handle -> one tint (--vb-surface-sunken, the grip's hover) over the grip, the title and the count, with the grip's dots and cursor grab; kept while the frame moves (data-dragging)

mouse over the title, or keyboard focus on the grip or anywhere in the label group, while the title is cut (titleTip flag) -> the tip opens below the title with its full text; it stays while the pointer is on the title or the tip and while focus is in the label group, and closes on leave, blur, Esc (focus stays) or a press outside (touch: a tap on the title opens it)
button[data-revoke] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> confirm, then the revoke action for that holder (agentAccess flag)
whenToUse: The frame of every area of the board that has its own layout mode.
whenNotToUse: Lane bands and labels inside a region (the wires layer draws them until <vb-link> arrives); cards (<vb-node>).
narrow: The label sits in the middle of the top line: the line's bar (.vb-region-bar) is a grid of three columns, the label's between two equal flexible ones, the tools' never narrower than the tools; with room the label is centred on the frame, and as the line narrows on screen it slides left beside the tools, never onto them, until the first column (--region-lead) is gone, and only then is the title cut. In the collapsed forms below, and zoomed out, the first column is closed (the label starts the line): the expanded row leaves the flow, and the full row leaves no room to centre there anyway, so the label never jumps (FE_02). The top line is the container query (its on-screen width; region-narrow.css): under 408px (a 440px frame at 100%), or under 568px with a retired marker, the row collapses and the label's parts sit closer; under 290px the retired marker shows its icon and number in place of its words; under 226px (261px with a marker) the row keeps only the cog, and Comment while its badge shows (the rest at no width, still focusable, so the row expands on hover or focus), and the holders leave the line. Under 568px (a 600px frame) the popover drops to compact tiles: icon and name, with the highlighted layout's one-liner on one line under them. So nothing on the label side is covered from FAR_K (55%) to 250% (review polish round 2 rulings 1 and 2). The holders give way first, then the title (one line ending in an ellipsis, never broken mid-word, down to about three letters), then the count ("1/1"; review polish ruling 9, N41); each holder and the count leave whole, never a clipped sliver: the holders' slot and the handle are wrapping rows one line high whose second line is clipped, so a part with no room wraps out of sight and stays in the accessible tree, and a holder with keyboard focus keeps its room (FIX_48). The full title is in the tip (titleTip flag). Popovers of the top line (layout, settings menu, note preview, title tip) draw above the row at every frame width.
accessibility: A labelled region landmark named by its heading. The layout icons are radios in a labelled radiogroup (one Tab stop, arrow keys between them, Enter or Space applies); the popover is a role=tooltip described onto the icon it is about. The cog is a menu button (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls) for a labelled role=menu with two menuitems: Reset places, aria-disabled with a described hint (No cards moved) when there is nothing to reset, and Put container back, aria-disabled with a described hint (Not moved) when the container has no place of its own. The grip is a real button named "Move container <title>" with aria-keyshortcuts for Alt+arrows, always in the tab order (its dots show on hover and focus). Comment is a button named "Comment on container <title>" (aria-haspopup=dialog) in the row's roving Tab stop; its name says the badge (", 1 unsent note" or ", 1 sent note waiting for the agent"), and the badge itself is aria-hidden. While the preview is open Comment is aria-describedby its text. The preview is a non-modal role=dialog labelled "Note on container <title>" (not a tooltip: it holds buttons), placed right after the row so Tab from Comment reaches Edit and Show in container / Hide; Esc closes it and returns focus to Comment (WCAG 1.4.13: hoverable, persistent, dismissible). The note block is a role=group labelled "Note on container <title>" with named Edit and Remove buttons (unsent only) and a Show all / Show less button (aria-expanded, aria-controls the text). The title is the heading with its full text even when the ellipsis cuts it; the tip repeats it for sighted users and is aria-hidden, so a screen reader never reads it twice (WCAG 1.4.13: hoverable, persistent, Esc dismisses). A removable holder is a real button named "<label>: remove access"; the creator is plain text.
far: The whole top line keeps one on-screen size at every zoom (review polish ruling 2): a counter-scale of --vb-zoom, which the viewport writes once on the world (registered, not inherited; the regions layer, the frame and the line inherit it explicitly), with the line's width tied to the frame's on-screen width. Below FAR_K the stage carries data-zoom=far and the row (its popover and menu with it), the grip, the retired marker and the holders leave the line (display: none), like the cards' buttons (N8), so the title takes their room; the label starts the line (FE_02: zooming out only ever moves a title left).
